note: Closed tool surface for AI agents building on Chronarch (Phase 5). OpenAI-style function schemas. Every call is JSON in / JSON out with the {ok,error_code,result,ring_hash,evidence_refs} envelope. There is deliberately no activate_faculty, execute_upgrade, edit_ring, or helm_override tool: authored code stays inert, upgrades go through Proposal + Ballot (G14), history is append-only (G1).

function.name: init
function.description: Boot/attach the agent to its kernel and return identity head, ring0/kernel hashes, and live faculty ids.

function.name: recall
function.description: Fetch CAS objects by content hash and re-verify each hash before use. A missing or tampered ref returns EVIDENCE_MISSING. Never trust the prompt; cite rings.

function.name: pin
function.description: Put an object into the CAS lane and return its content hash. Retrieval is later challengeable (I3).

function.name: challenge
function.description: Run a live-registry faculty replay and judge it by replay-hash equality. Judgment takes no payment/self_poq parameter (G2).

function.name: seal
function.description: Seal a validated ring onto the ledger. The body is screened against forbidden keys (K18); an admin_key body is rejected. Cannot seal governance/lifecycle ring types.

function.name: propose
function.description: Submit a Proposal to the Council. This is the ONLY path to a major change (G14). The agent cannot enact it; the Council votes.

function.name: ballot
function.description: Cast a Ballot on a proposal (only meaningful for a bonded, seated identity).

function.name: health
function.description: Publish and return this epoch's HealthVector (9 components, 0..10000 bps).

function.name: turn
function.description: One wear-loop turn: recall+verify evidence, run a live faculty via DummyMind, attach advisory self_poq metadata, then admit and seal (or propose). Authored code stays inert; self_poq never enters judgment.

function.name: task_open
function.description: Open a Continuum task chain for a long job and seal a pointer ring on the identity chain. Task work never splices into identity (G8).

function.name: task_resume
function.description: Append progress to an open Continuum task chain and return its head. Identity chain stays a pointer, not a task dump.
